items.exampleEn: After two years of drought, the lake was only half full.
items.exampleZh: 經過兩年乾旱，湖水只剩一半。

items.exampleEn: An icy wind blew through the open window all night.
items.exampleZh: 冰冷的風整晚從開著的窗戶吹進來。

items.exampleEn: Environmentally, the new road will do more harm than good.
items.exampleZh: 就環境而言，這條新路弊大於利。

items.exampleEn: Children learn best in a calm and friendly environment.
items.exampleZh: 孩子在平靜友善的環境中學得最好。

items.exampleEn: Scientists discovered a new species of frog in the rainforest.
items.exampleZh: 科學家在雨林中發現了一種新的青蛙物種。

items.exampleEn: Snow covers the peak of the mountain all year.
Solar storms can sometimes affect radio signals on earth.
items.exampleZh: 太陽風暴有時會影響地球上的無線電訊號。

items.exampleEn: A deer and her baby stood quietly at the edge of the forest.
items.exampleZh: 一頭母鹿和牠的寶寶靜靜地站在森林邊。

items.sentenceEn: Be careful when you drive; the roads are icy this morning.
items.sentenceZh: 開車要小心，今天早上路面結冰了。

items.audioEn: We reached the peak of the mountain just after sunrise, and the view was amazing.
items.audioZh: 我們在日出後不久抵達山頂，景色美極了。
items.questionZh: 他們什麼時候抵達山頂？

items.sentenceEn: Plastic in the sea is harming many species of fish and birds.
items.sentenceZh: 海洋中的塑膠正在傷害許多種魚類和鳥類。

items.sentenceEn: Farmers are worried that the drought will ruin this year's crops.
items.sentenceZh: 農民擔心乾旱會毀了今年的作物。

items.stemEn: We should protect the ____ by using less plastic and saving water.
items.stemZh: 我們應該少用塑膠、節約用水來保護環境。

items.stemEn: Our village gets most of its electricity from ____ power.
items.stemZh: 我們村子大部分的電力來自太陽能。

items.passageEn: Last spring, our science class visited a nature park in the mountains. The guide, a well-known explorer, explained that a long drought had made life hard for many species in the area. Deer had moved higher up the mountain to find water, and some birds had not returned at all. To protect the environment, the park now uses solar power and asks visitors to take their trash home. We climbed to the peak, where the wind was icy even in spring. Our teacher said that living in an environmentally responsible way is not only the job of scientists, but everyone's job.
items.passageZh: 去年春天，我們自然課去參觀山上的一座自然公園。導覽員是一位知名的探險家，他說明，一場長期乾旱讓這一帶的許多物種生活變得艱難。鹿為了找水搬到更高的山上，有些鳥則根本沒有再回來。為了保護環境，公園現在使用太陽能，並請遊客把垃圾帶回家。我們爬到山頂，那裡的風即使在春天也冷得像冰。老師說，以愛護環境的方式生活，不只是科學家的工作，而是每個人的責任。

questions.questionZh: 鹿為什麼搬到更高的山上？

options: 愛護環境是每個人的責任
科學家才懂得保護自然
公園應該禁止遊客進入

referenceEn: This new packaging is more environmentally friendly.
The new packaging is more environmentally friendly than the old one.
rubricZh: environmentally 修飾形容詞（例如 environmentally friendly）

items.promptZh: 這座島上的鹿一點也不怕人。
referenceEn: The deer on this island are not afraid of people at all.
The deer on this island aren't scared of people at all.
rubricZh: deer 單複數同形，不加 s；動詞用 are 或 is 都可以（例如 The deer… are 等）
「一點也不怕」可寫，例如 not afraid of… at all、not scared of… at all 等
